properties.notes: Potential opportunity for redevelopment of existing listed buildings within town centre through urban infill. Previously occupied by a bank but now vacant. Scheme for change of use to 1 three-bed and 4 two-bed dwellings consented but permission has lapsed (12/00255/FUL). High density of development would be fitting to reflect conversion scheme in the heart of the town centre.
